user.description: Leave host and port blank to talk to a local telldusd directly through USB. Fill in both to reach a telldusd over the network (requires telldusd to be reachable over TCP). The HA add-on app is reached over the network, and should have been autodiscovered, so just use the suggested values.

reconfigure.description: Leave host and port blank to talk to a local telldusd directly through USB. Fill in both to reach a telldusd over the network (requires telldusd to be reachable over TCP). The HA add-on app is reached over the network, and should have been autodiscovered, so just use the suggested values.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. For local mode, make sure the TellStick is plugged in and a TellStick daemon (e.g. the Telldus add-on) is running. For network mode, check the host and both ports.

abort.already_configured: Tellstick is already configured. Only one TellStick is supported per Home Assistant instance.

abort.use_discovery: Sensors are added automatically when they're heard broadcasting -- check Settings → System → Repairs for any pending new sensors.

deprecated_yaml.title: The Tellstick YAML configuration is deprecated
deprecated_yaml.description: Configuring Tellstick via `configuration.yaml` is deprecated and your config has been imported into the UI automatically. Remove the `tellstick:` section from your YAML files.

init.description: Heard a new sensor broadcasting: protocol `{protocol}`, model `{model}`, id `{sensor_id}`. TellStick reception picks up anything in range, including a neighbor's equipment -- only add it if it's actually yours.

abort.ignored: Ignored. Won't ask about this sensor again.
abort.entry_not_found: The Tellstick integration entry this sensor belongs to no longer exists.
